Job Description
YOUR MISSION
Keep the Environment team on track and ensure assets meet the established quality, technical, and delivery standards. Coordinate daily production, support artists, identify blockers early, and keep the 3D Lead informed..
Your quest begins
Be the day-to-day point of contact for the Environment team, by keeping tasks moving from blockout to final asset, coordinating feedback, and making sure nothing gets stuck in the pipeline.
Daily power-ups

• Coordinate tasks, priorities, workload, and milestones.
• Monitor asset progress, deadlines, and deliverables.
• Review assets against established art and technical standards and provide feedback.
• Follow up on revisions, blockers, dependencies, and missing information.
• Support artists with production and technical issues, escalating complex matters when needed.
• Coordinate Environment-related feedback with the 3D Lead and other teams.
• Report progress, risks, and quality concerns to the 3D Lead.
• Support knowledge sharing, onboarding, and day-to-day artist development.
Your allies

• 3D Lead
• Environment Artists
• Art Director & Art Team
• Producers / Project Leads
• International & Partner Studios

Leveling Up
6 Months : Level Up Yourself

• Master the Environment pipeline and team workflow.
• Keep tasks, quality, and milestones on track.
• Identify blockers early and build strong team collaboration
12 Months : Level Up the Team

• Improve delivery predictability and reduce rework.
• Help artists improve their skills and independence.
• Improve Environment workflows and support the 3D Lead.
Next mission briefing

• 1st Contact : Preliminary call with TA team
• Test: Technical test
• Second interview: Art Director and 3D lead
Your next level : Coordinator è 3D lead è Art director

Qualifications
YOUR TOOLKIT

• Environment Crafting, Modelling, texturing & materials
• Engine Ready, Unreal / Unity & asset optimization
• Quality Check, Asset review & production standards
• Quest Tracking, Tasks, milestones & delivery follow-up
• Team Buff, Artist support & day-to-day coordination
YOUR PLAYER PROFILE

• Quest Keeper, Organized & reliable
• Problem Solver, Proactive & solution-oriented
• Team Player, Clear & collaborative communicator
• Party Support, Supportive & approachable
• Quality Hunter, Detail-oriented & quality-focused

Additional Information
YOUR REWARDS
Loots & Perks

• Hybrid Quest, Work rom the office 2 days per week, with the flexibility of hybrid working
• Health Coverage, Private medical insurance for you, your spouse & 2 children
• Time to Recharge , Up to 20 days annual leave + additional special leave, exclude the public holiday and sick leaves
• Eid THR, Annual Eid-ul-Fitri holiday allowance in line with Indonesian regulations, up to 1 time salary
• Performance Bonus , Recognition based on your contribution and performance
• Family Support , Maternity, paternity & family care leave
• Wellbeing & Community , Wellbeing activities, employee clubs & team building
• Extra Rewards, Seniority recognition & employee referral program

Guild life
At Gameloft, you’ll work with a global team of game makers, collaborating across studios to create games played by millions while growing your skills in a creative, flexible, and supportive environment.

Ready to hit start?
Apply now with your CV in English and don’t forget to attach your portfolio; portfolio submissions are required for your application to be considered.
